creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Doing: spawning Codex and Claude panes from an agent for a mixed-harness demo (2026-10-05, Muster 0.13.0, codex-cli 0.159.0 and 0.160.0).

Codex's startup dialog "Hooks need review" offers `› 1. Review hooks`, `2. Trust all and continue`, `3. Continue without trusting`. The person asked the agent to pick 2 in both panes. `muster pane send --pane X 2` changed nothing: pane send delivers text as a paste, and Codex's dialogs ignore pastes (docs/observations/codex-0.154.0.md, section 6, says the same of its approval prompt). `--enter` presses Return, which takes the highlighted option, here 1. So the only answers an agent can give a dialog are the highlighted option and nothing, and the person had to press 2 in each pane by hand. Claude Code's plan dialog has the same limit (parallel-work works around it by amending before the dialog opens).

Wanted: a way to send keys rather than a paste, e.g. `muster pane send --key down --key enter` or `--keys`, typed as key events so a dialog's own navigation sees them. Docs (`muster docs agents`, limits) would then say which keys exist.
title: ⌨️ pane send can only take a dialog's highlighted option
